evidence_boundary: Both current-run experiments are local mechanism tests. They are not live FRANK, target Qwen3-4B, Android, production database, production security or independent conceptual replications.

experiments.source_relation: Fresh in-progress CC12 query-semantics lab was discovered in GitHub; fusion executed the same declared semantics locally against SQLite with seed 44119.
experiments.interpretation: Collection algebra is not a cosmetic storage detail. A lowerer that erases SET/ORDERED/MULTISET semantics can change multiplicity/order and therefore candidate-set identity. Correct typed lowering matched the reference for all constructed cases. This strengthens MOSAIC selection-plan identity and UnifiedDB query receipts, but does not prove all adapters or WEIGHTED/PRIORITY semantics.

experiments.setup: Each episode had one relevant memory target and 19 distractors. Retrieval-only used noisy relevance. Truthful activation boosted the target. Stale/revoked activation boosted a wrong candidate with ancestry detectable as invalid. Role-shuffled activation boosted a wrong but individually authentic candidate. A deterministic ancestry filter removed only the stale/revoked candidate before reselection.
experiments.interpretation: In this construction, truthful activation can greatly alter useful availability, stale invalid ancestry can be contained by deterministic receipts, and role-shuffled but authentic misleading activation cannot be fixed by integrity checks alone. Therefore structural integrity and cognitive relevance/causal utility are distinct validation layers. Absolute accuracies are chosen-model synthetic outcomes, not FRANK estimates.

combined_delta: The whole mesh should distinguish (1) deterministic semantic/integrity certification from (2) empirical cognitive utility. Certification can prove identity, provenance, epoch, collection algebra, selection plan and authority constraints; it cannot prove that an authentic association is the right one for the current task.
